page.overview:
Who is Avldovn Rascinet?

Avldovn Rascinet, born Vlad von Carstein XV (not to be confused with his infamous namesake, the Vampire Lord Vlad von Carstein), was a scion of the mortal branch of the noble von Carstein family of Sylvania.

Rascinet descends from the necromancer Johann Haifisch, whose family was adopted by the von Carsteins as their own after offering their daughters to the new Count of Sylvania after the Vampire Lord Vlad von Carstein first seized power. The magical potency of these mortal von Carsteins increases greatly when they are transformed by the Blood Kiss into Vampires, so the two lines of the family have existed alongside each other, intertwined for centuries.

Intended to be the first of a new breed of Vampires upon the return of their lord Mannfred von Carstein, Rascinet instead ran away from home to pursue his own dreams, currently living in the Imperial capital Altdorf.

Using the identity of Avldovn Rascinet (an anagram of Vlad von Carstein), he started working at the Vargr Breughel Memorial Theatre as a scene-shifter, dreaming of working as a ventriloquist. Using a puppet called "Vlad von Carstein" for his act, he became a popular comedian, while rejecting any attempts from Vampires to give him the Blood Kiss.
